purpose: File interface for the offline measurement-control check utility.
command: python measurement_check.py --mass MASS.csv --optical OPTICAL.csv --config SETTINGS.json --output DIRECTORY

input.record_ids: Unique, nonempty within each file. Row order does not determine baseline membership. Paths may contain spaces.
input.required_values: Finite measurements, nonnegative residual SD, positive degrees, positive integer control days. Each optical day has the configured count of distinct reference positions L/M/U. At least two baseline and two monitoring records.
input.configuration: All control settings are read from the supplied JSON. The family method is sidak; supported controls_per_day values match distinct L/M/U positions.
input.system_scope: One mass system per run: all balance_id, check_standard_id and design_id combinations must be nonempty and identical. Reject mixed systems rather than pooling their records.

output.json_types: Counts are numbers; failure flags and completed_remeasurement_confirmed are Booleans. Use null for an unknown affected_customer_work_count. product_conformity is not_determined when specifications and linked work are absent. Additional fields are allowed.
output.record_arrays: Exactly one result per received record and one daily result per observed optical day. Ordering is unrestricted.
output.exception_rows: One row per failing metric. system: mass/optical; scope: baseline/monitoring/control_day. measurement: check_value/residual_sd/control_error. unit: ug/um. Blank control_day for mass; blank lower_limit for the one-sided precision check. No row for a non-failing metric.
output.precision: Retain enough precision to recompute and classify the limits (absolute numerical agreement 1e-8). Equality to a limit is within limits.
output.failure_behavior: Invalid or incomplete inputs return a nonzero exit code and a useful stderr message. Do not emit success-result files for invalid data.

offline: No downloads, network calls or embedded answer tables. Declare any installed Python dependencies in requirements.txt.
runtime: Finish each review within 60 seconds for a record set of this size on the supplied environment.
